intent: Measures perf metrics against a stored baseline (product-scope memory), flags a regression only past a threshold, moves the baseline only on a deliberate trade logged as a decision, treats a first run as a capture not a failure, and measures without fixing.

dimensions.name: baseline-persisted
dimensions.criterion: Compares against a baseline persisted in the product-scope memory store.

dimensions.name: threshold-not-noise
dimensions.criterion: A metric regresses only past a stated threshold, so variance doesn't cry wolf.

dimensions.name: deliberate-rebaseline
dimensions.criterion: The baseline moves only on an intended trade, recorded as a decision.

dimensions.name: measure-not-fix
dimensions.criterion: Quantifies the regression; the fix is a separate job (/investigate).

dimensions.name: first-capture
dimensions.criterion: A first run with no baseline is a capture, not a reported regression.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the verdict as a run artifact.
